content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial cannot be cured by resubmission because authorization was required at service, retroactive authorization is unavailable, and the payer offers no peer-to-peer review. Although similar appeals rarely succeeded, a formal medical-necessity appeal is the only compliant payer path still available and has at least some demonstrated success; patient billing is premature before that path is exhausted.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
